findings.finding: The Lane F PASS gate never states a per-component minimum evidence class. The plan requires stated-vs-measured separation per component (item 9), an account-bound channel, no swap=0 substitution, and no unattached internet numbers, but a lane could in principle self-grade PASS_BROKER_COST_AUTHORITY with financing/swap components in an account-attached-but-STATED class. FOREX-NG7 died exactly on financing NOT_MEASURABLE (twice-independent census) and Q-8 makes vendor-stated constants hypotheses, so an under-specified PASS minimum is the one leaky-PASS path in the plan. The G5 terminal A7 auditing under the plan's own Q-8 binding would catch it, but the gate should be sharp before dispatch, not at audit.

The CNG4-A3 contract's restatements were exact (1296/1440, 324/360). Additionally the per-fold 90% valid-triad floor (CNG4: >= 324/360 per fold) is not restated for the 2x7d fold structure (would be >= 152/168 per fold); only the total and the >= 4 cells/control/fold floor are restated.

fourteen_day_floor_adjudication: LAWFUL frozen owner-scoped choice, not a dishonest weakening - with one mandatory precision fix (F-D1) and one standing condition (F-D2). Grounds: (1) The owner directive enumerated WHAT must be frozen before collection (minimum coverage duration, minimum complete samples, weekend requirement, high-volatility/event requirement, outcome-independent stopping rule) but did not set the number; the Lead's plan freezes 14 consecutive UTC days BEFORE any collection and discloses the change against the adopted CNG4 60-day contract - Q-9 seal-the-criteria is honored. (2) What a 14-day PASS authorizes is scoped in the plan itself: it measures 'whether the plane is healthy, not whether it is complete'; the 60-day full floor 'remains the successor's bar and is restated in the contract'. So PASS_PROSPECTIVE_CONTROL_AUTHORITY at 14 days is a control-authority (data-plane health + stream identity) statement, consistent with the directive's own verdict name, and unlocks only the right to PROPOSE CRYPTO-NG5 - which still faces one family, max 3 scored cells, the full ancestry battery carrying the crypto killers, D2 non-scored, fresh-context A7 prelaunch, and an exact owner GO at its own gate. Nothing scored is authorized by this cycle. (3) The plan honestly marks the 14-day PASS as 'honestly unlikely'; the realistic terminal is WAITING_COVERAGE with resumable state, which permits NO successor - so the 14-day floor mostly governs when a healthy plane may stop, a resource decision, not an evidence loosening. (4) The 60-day bar surviving in the frozen contract means no successor can inherit a completeness claim from 14 days. Conditions that keep it lawful: (a) F-D1 must be fixed at the contract freeze (>= 303/336 total, >= 152/168 per fold, exact integers, committed before collector start) - a frozen floor with an internal off-by-one is exactly where a soft PASS would breed; (b) the 60-day successor bar must verifiably appear in the committed contract text; (c) per F-D2, CRYPTO-NG5's own plan must name its data window explicitly and its prelaunch A7 adjudicates it. A 14-day PASS therefore authorizes exactly: 'the cross-venue plane ran clean under the frozen identity/quality contract for 14 days and may serve as a prospective control plane' - nothing more.
